steps.title: Single K/V block: S, softmax, O and LSE
Full outer K/V loop: O/l/m reside in HBM and are rescaled
Causal mask and skipping fully masked blocks

cases.name: n1
cases.purpose: N=1: only one key, P must be exactly 1, O = V, LSE = scale·q·k. Checks that the tail mask does not also mask the only key.

cases.name: one_block
cases.purpose: N exactly equals Bc=64: one full block; B>1, H>1 check the mapping of (b,h) to CTAs and row addresses.

cases.name: short_tail
cases.purpose: N=37 < 64 and D=128: the 27 padding keys in the block must be masked; at D=128 each thread is responsible for two groups of O columns.

cases.name: short_peaked
cases.purpose: A very peaked softmax (logits differ by tens): not subtracting m~ overflows, and a wrong m~ or l~ shows up directly.

cases.name: two_blocks
cases.purpose: Two K/V blocks, large logits: the second block may bring a larger maximum, and the old O and l must be rescaled by e^(m_old-m_new).

cases.name: tail
cases.purpose: N=300 is not a multiple of 64: the last Q block and the last K/V block each have only 44 valid rows.

cases.name: rescale
cases.purpose: Several blocks, large logits, D=128: the maximum keeps changing in later blocks, testing the scaling of every merge.

cases.name: uniform
cases.purpose: Q=0: all keys have equal weights, O is the mean of V, LSE = ln(N). A wrong initial value of l or a wrong merge deviates from ln(N).

cases.name: ones_v
cases.purpose: V=1: O must equal 1. Tests that the normalization of l_new and O is consistent (dividing by l one time too many or too few deviates from 1).

cases.name: position
cases.purpose: V[j]=j/N: a wrong K/V block offset or row stride gives clearly wrong position values.

cases.name: medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size random data: the full outer loop over 16 K/V blocks.

cases.name: causal_n1
cases.purpose: Causal and N=1: the only query sees only itself.

cases.name: causal_two_blocks
cases.purpose: Causal, two blocks, large logits: the mask inside the diagonal block and the skipped block (Q block 0 does not see K block 1).

cases.name: causal_tail
cases.purpose: Causal and N not a multiple of the block size: the diagonal-block mask and the tail mask apply at the same time.

cases.name: causal_position
cases.purpose: Causal, V[j]=j/N, D=128: O of query i may come only from j<=i; a mask off by one reads position values from the future.

cases.name: causal_peaked
cases.purpose: Causal and large logits: skipped blocks must not leave a wrong m/l behind.

cases.name: causal_uniform
cases.purpose: Causal and Q=0: O[i] is the mean of V[0..i], LSE[i] = ln(i+1).

cases.name: causal_ones_v
cases.purpose: Causal and V=1: O must equal 1, including row 0 (which has only one key).

cases.name: causal_medium
cases.purpose: Medium-size causal: each K/V block processes only the Q blocks on and below the diagonal.

cases.name: few_heads
cases.purpose: Only B·H=16 CTAs (148 SMs): belongs to no step; use ./lab bench 12 --case few_heads to observe that "one CTA per head" cannot fill the GPU.

cases.name: perf
cases.purpose: B·H=256 CTAs, N=4096: the full FA1 outer K/V loop, with O/l/m making a round trip through HBM for every block.

cases.name: perf_causal
cases.purpose: Same as above but causal: after skipping fully masked blocks, the work is about half.
